author: Traditionally Moses
传统上认为是摩西
about: The book of beginnings: the creation of the world, the fall of mankind, the flood, and God's promise to Abraham carried through Isaac, Jacob and Joseph.
起初之书：记载天地的创造、人的堕落、洪水，以及神给亚伯拉罕的应许如何经由以撒、雅各和约瑟延续下去。

author: Traditionally Moses
传统上认为是摩西
about: God hears Israel in slavery, calls Moses, brings the people out of Egypt, gives the law at Sinai and comes to dwell among them in the tabernacle.
神垂听以色列人在为奴之地的哀声，呼召摩西，领百姓出埃及，在西奈山颁布律法，并在会幕中住在他们中间。

author: Traditionally Moses
传统上认为是摩西
about: Instructions given at Sinai for how a sinful people may live near a holy God: offerings, priests, clean and unclean, the Day of Atonement and holy living.
在西奈所颁布的条例，教导有罪的百姓如何亲近圣洁的神：献祭、祭司、洁与不洁、赎罪日和圣洁的生活。

author: Traditionally Moses
传统上认为是摩西
about: Israel is counted at Sinai, refuses to enter Canaan, wanders forty years in the wilderness, and a new generation is counted on the plains of Moab.
以色列人在西奈被数点，却不肯进入迦南，在旷野漂流四十年；新的一代在摩押平原再次被数点。

author: Traditionally Moses
传统上认为是摩西
about: Moses' farewell sermons on the plains of Moab, retelling the journey and the law, and calling Israel to love the LORD before they enter the land.
摩西在摩押平原的临别讲论，重述旅程与律法，呼吁以色列人在进入应许之地前要尽心爱耶和华。

author: Traditionally Joshua, with later additions
传统上认为是约书亚，后人有所补充
about: Joshua leads Israel across the Jordan, takes the land of Canaan, divides it among the tribes and calls them to serve the LORD alone.
约书亚领以色列人过约旦河，攻取迦南地，按支派分地，并呼召百姓专一事奉耶和华。

author: Unknown; tradition names Samuel
作者不详，传统上认为是撒母耳
about: A cycle repeated again and again: Israel turns from God, falls to its enemies, cries out, and God raises a judge to save them.
一个不断重复的循环：以色列人离弃神，被仇敌欺压，向神哀求，神就兴起士师拯救他们。

author: Unknown; tradition names Samuel
作者不详，传统上认为是撒母耳
date: Set in the time of the judges
about: A Moabite widow stays loyal to her mother-in-law, finds a redeemer in Boaz of Bethlehem, and becomes the great-grandmother of King David.
一位摩押寡妇忠心跟随婆婆，在伯利恒遇见至近的亲属波阿斯作她的救赎者，后来成为大卫王的曾祖母。

author: Unknown; drawn from Samuel, Nathan and Gad
作者不详，取材于撒母耳、拿单、迦得的记录
about: Israel moves from judges to kings: Samuel the last judge, Saul the first king and his fall, and the rise of David.
以色列从士师时代进入君王时代：最后一位士师撒母耳，第一位君王扫罗的兴起与失败，以及大卫的兴起。

author: Unknown; drawn from Nathan and Gad
作者不详，取材于拿单、迦得的记录
about: David's reign: king of Judah, then all Israel, God's covenant of an everlasting throne, his sin with Bathsheba and the troubles that follow.
大卫作王的记录：先作犹大王，后作全以色列的王；神与他立永远国位的约；他与拔示巴犯罪以及随后的家庭祸患。

author: Unknown; tradition names Jeremiah
作者不详，传统上认为是耶利米
about: Solomon's wisdom and temple, the split of the kingdom into Israel and Judah, and Elijah's stand against Baal.
所罗门的智慧与圣殿，王国分裂为以色列和犹大，以及以利亚对抗巴力。

author: Unknown; tradition names Jeremiah
作者不详，传统上认为是耶利米
about: Elisha's ministry and the kings of both kingdoms until Israel falls to Assyria and Judah to Babylon.
以利沙的事工，以及南北两国诸王的事迹，直到以色列亡于亚述、犹大亡于巴比伦。

author: Traditionally Ezra
传统上认为是以斯拉
about: Retold for the returned exiles: genealogies from Adam, then David's reign with a focus on the ark, worship and preparing for the temple.
为归回的百姓重述历史：从亚当起的家谱，接着是大卫的作王，着重于约柜、敬拜和预备建殿。

author: Traditionally Ezra
传统上认为是以斯拉
about: The kings of Judah from Solomon to the exile, judged by how they kept the temple and its worship, ending with Cyrus' call to return.
从所罗门到被掳的犹大诸王，以他们是否持守圣殿与敬拜为衡量，结尾是古列王准许归回的诏书。
outline: Exile and the call to return

author: Traditionally Ezra
传统上认为是以斯拉
about: The exiles return from Babylon under Zerubbabel and rebuild the temple; later Ezra comes to teach the law and call the people back to it.
被掳的人在所罗巴伯带领下从巴比伦归回并重建圣殿；后来以斯拉回来教导律法，呼召百姓回转。

author: Nehemiah, with Ezra
尼希米，可能经以斯拉编辑
about: Nehemiah leaves the Persian court to rebuild Jerusalem's walls against opposition, then joins Ezra in renewing the people's covenant.
尼希米离开波斯王宫，在反对声中重修耶路撒冷城墙，又与以斯拉一同带领百姓重新立约。

author: Unknown
作者不详
about: A Jewish queen of Persia risks her life to save her people from Haman's plot; God is never named, yet his hand is everywhere. The origin of Purim.
一位犹太女子作了波斯王后，冒生命危险拯救同胞脱离哈曼的阴谋。书中没有提到神的名，却处处可见神的作为。也是普珥节的由来。

author: Unknown
作者不详
date: Unknown; set in the time of the patriarchs
年代不详，背景约在族长时代
about: A righteous man loses everything. He and his friends argue over why he suffers, until God speaks out of the whirlwind.
一位义人失去了一切。他与朋友们争论他为何受苦，直到神从旋风中说话。
outline: 约伯与三位朋友的辩论

author: David and others, including Asaph, the sons of Korah and Moses
大卫及亚萨、可拉的后裔、摩西等人
about: Israel's songbook and prayer book: 150 psalms of praise, lament, thanks, wisdom and hope in God's anointed king, gathered into five books.
以色列的诗歌与祷告集：一百五十篇赞美、哀歌、感恩、智慧以及对受膏君王之盼望的诗篇，共分为五卷。

author: Mainly Solomon, with Agur and Lemuel
主要是所罗门，另有亚古珥和利慕伊勒
about: Short sayings and longer lessons on living wisely in the fear of the LORD, at home, at work and with words.
以敬畏耶和华为根基，用简短箴言和较长的教训，教导人在家庭、工作和言语上如何活得有智慧。
outline: 希西家臣仆所誊录的箴言
亚古珥与利慕伊勒的话

author: The Preacher, traditionally Solomon
传道者，传统上认为是所罗门
about: The Preacher searches for meaning "under the sun" in work, pleasure and wisdom, finds it all vanity, and ends: fear God and keep his commandments.
传道者在“日光之下”从工作、享乐与智慧中寻找意义，发现都是虚空，最后总结：敬畏神，谨守他的诫命。

author: Traditionally Solomon
传统上认为是所罗门
about: Love poems between a bride and her beloved, celebrating love and marriage; often read as a picture of God's love for his people.
新妇与良人之间的爱情诗歌，赞美爱情与婚姻；也常被理解为神爱他子民的图画。

author: Isaiah son of Amoz
亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚
about: Isaiah warns Judah of judgment, then comforts them with promises of return, a coming king, the suffering servant, and new heavens and a new earth.
以赛亚警告犹大将受审判，又以归回、将来的君王、受苦的仆人以及新天新地的应许安慰他们。
outline: 以赛亚蒙召与以马内利

author: Jeremiah, with his scribe Baruch
耶利米，及其书记巴录
about: The weeping prophet calls Judah to repent through its last kings, sees Jerusalem fall to Babylon, and promises a new covenant written on the heart.
流泪的先知在犹大最后几位君王的时代呼吁百姓悔改，目睹耶路撒冷亡于巴比伦，并应许神要立新约，写在人心上。

author: Traditionally Jeremiah
传统上认为是耶利米
about: Five poems of grief over fallen Jerusalem; at their centre, hope that the LORD's mercies are new every morning.
为陷落的耶路撒冷所写的五首哀歌；在中心处宣告盼望：耶和华的怜悯每早晨都是新的。

author: Ezekiel the priest
祭司以西结
about: A priest in exile in Babylon sees God's glory leave the temple, warns of Jerusalem's fall, and then sees dry bones live and a new temple.
一位在巴比伦被掳的祭司看见神的荣耀离开圣殿，警告耶路撒冷必倾覆，后又看见枯骨复活与新的圣殿。

author: Daniel
但以理
about: Daniel and his friends stay faithful in the court of Babylon, and Daniel's visions show God ruling over the rise and fall of empires.
但以理和他的朋友在巴比伦宫廷中持守信仰；但以理的异象显明神掌管列国的兴衰。

author: Hosea
何西阿
about: God tells Hosea to marry an unfaithful wife and win her back, a living picture of his love for unfaithful Israel.
神吩咐何西阿娶不贞的妻子并再次赎回她，活生生地描绘神对不忠的以色列的爱。
outline: God's love will not let go

author: Joel son of Pethuel
毗土珥的儿子约珥
date: 年代不详，或约主前835年或500年
about: A locust plague becomes a warning of the day of the LORD, and a promise that God will pour out his Spirit on all flesh.
一场蝗灾成为耶和华日子的警告，也带出神要将他的灵浇灌凡有血气之人的应许。
outline: Return, and the Spirit poured out
归向耶和华与浇灌圣灵

author: Amos, a shepherd of Tekoa
提哥亚的牧人阿摩司
about: A farmer from Judah is sent north to prosperous Israel to condemn their injustice and empty worship: let justice roll down like waters.
一位犹大的牧人被差往富裕的北国以色列，斥责他们的不公与虚假敬拜：惟愿公平如大水滚滚。

author: Obadiah
俄巴底亚
about: The shortest book of the Old Testament: Edom will be judged for gloating over Jerusalem's fall, and the kingdom will be the LORD's.
旧约最短的书：以东因幸灾乐祸于耶路撒冷的陷落而受审判，国度必归耶和华。

author: Traditionally Jonah
传统上认为是约拿
about: A prophet runs from God's call, is swallowed by a great fish, preaches to Nineveh, and is angry when God shows the city mercy.
一位先知逃避神的呼召，被大鱼吞下，后到尼尼微传道，当神怜悯这城时他却发怒。

author: Micah of Moresheth
摩利沙人弥迦
about: Micah condemns the injustice of Israel and Judah, foretells a ruler from Bethlehem, and sums up what the LORD requires.
弥迦斥责以色列和犹大的不公，预言有一位掌权者要从伯利恒出来，并总结耶和华对人的要求。
outline: Who is a God like you

author: Nahum the Elkoshite
伊勒歌斯人那鸿
about: A poem of Nineveh's coming fall: the LORD is slow to anger but will not leave the cruel Assyrian empire unpunished.
预言尼尼微必倾覆的诗歌：耶和华不轻易发怒，却绝不以残暴的亚述为无罪。
outline: The LORD is good and just

author: Habakkuk
哈巴谷
about: A prophet asks God why evil goes unpunished, hears that Babylon is coming, and ends in faith: the just shall live by faith.
一位先知质问神为何恶人不受惩罚，得知巴比伦将要来临，最后以信心作结：义人因信得生。

author: Zephaniah
西番雅
about: In Josiah's day Zephaniah announces the great day of the LORD on Judah and the nations, then sings of God rejoicing over his people.
在约西亚年间，西番雅宣告耶和华的大日要临到犹大和列国，随后歌颂神因他的百姓欢欣喜乐。

author: Haggai
哈该
about: Haggai stirs the returned exiles to stop neglecting God's house and finish rebuilding the temple.
哈该激励归回的百姓不要再荒废神的殿，要完成重建圣殿的工作。
outline: The greater glory and the signet

author: Zechariah son of Berechiah
比利家的儿子撒迦利亚
about: Night visions encourage the temple builders, and later oracles look to a humble king riding on a donkey and a pierced one.
夜间的异象鼓励建殿的人；后段的预言则展望一位骑着驴驹的谦和君王，以及被扎的那一位。

author: Malachi
玛拉基
about: The last Old Testament prophet confronts careless priests and people, and promises a messenger like Elijah before the day of the LORD.
旧约最后一位先知斥责草率的祭司与百姓，并应许在耶和华的日子以前，要差遣以利亚那样的使者。

author: Matthew the tax collector, an apostle
使徒马太，曾是税吏
about: Written for Jewish readers: Jesus is the promised Messiah and son of David, who fulfils the Scriptures, teaches the kingdom of heaven and sends his disciples to all nations.
为犹太读者而写：耶稣是应许的弥赛亚、大卫的子孙，应验了经上的话，教导天国的道，并差遣门徒往万民中去。

author: John Mark, drawing on Peter
约翰马可，取材于彼得
about: The shortest and fastest-moving Gospel: Jesus the Son of God acts with authority, and came not to be served but to serve and give his life.
最简短、节奏最快的福音书：神的儿子耶稣满有权柄地行事，他来不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，并舍命。
outline: Who do you say I am?

author: Luke the physician, companion of Paul
医生路加，保罗的同工
about: An orderly account for Theophilus: Jesus the Saviour for all people, with special care for the poor, the outsider, women, prayer and the Holy Spirit.
写给提阿非罗的一卷按次序的记述：耶稣是万民的救主，特别关注贫穷人、被排斥的人、妇女、祷告与圣灵。

author: John the apostle, the disciple Jesus loved
使徒约翰，耶稣所爱的门徒
about: Written that you may believe: seven signs and seven "I am" sayings show Jesus as the Word made flesh, the Son of God who gives eternal life.
写这书是要叫人信：七个神迹和七个“我是”的宣告，显明耶稣是道成肉身、赐人永生的神的儿子。

author: Luke
路加
about: The sequel to Luke: the risen Jesus sends the Spirit, and the gospel spreads from Jerusalem to Judea, Samaria and on to Rome.
路加福音的续篇：复活的主差下圣灵，福音从耶路撒冷传到犹太、撒玛利亚，直到罗马。

author: Paul
保罗
about: Paul's fullest explanation of the gospel: all have sinned, all are justified freely by faith in Christ, and are given new life in the Spirit.
保罗对福音最完整的阐述：世人都犯了罪，却因信基督白白地称义，并在圣灵里得着新生命。

author: Paul
保罗
about: Paul answers a gifted but divided church on factions, sexual sin, marriage, worship, spiritual gifts, love and the resurrection.
保罗回应一个恩赐丰富却纷争不断的教会，论及结党、淫乱、婚姻、敬拜、属灵恩赐、爱和复活。

author: Paul
保罗
about: Paul's most personal letter: he defends his ministry, finds God's power made perfect in weakness, and asks for a generous gift for Jerusalem.
保罗最个人化的书信：他为自己的职分辩护，经历神的能力在软弱上显得完全，并劝众人慷慨捐助耶路撒冷的圣徒。
outline: The ministry of the new covenant

author: Paul
保罗
about: A passionate defence of the gospel of grace: we are justified by faith, not by the works of the law, and set free to walk by the Spirit.
为恩典的福音热切辩护：人称义是因信，不是因行律法；我们得了自由，当顺着圣灵而行。

author: Paul
保罗
about: Every spiritual blessing in Christ, Jew and Gentile made one body, and how that new life looks at church, at home and in spiritual battle.
在基督里得着各样属灵的福气，犹太人与外邦人成为一个身体，以及这新生命在教会、家庭和属灵争战中的样式。
outline: 行事为人与蒙召的恩相称

author: Paul
保罗
about: A letter of joy from prison: to live is Christ, have the humble mind of Christ, and press on toward the goal.
狱中所写的喜乐书信：活着就是基督，要以基督谦卑的心为心，向着标竿直跑。

author: Paul
保罗
about: Christ is supreme over all creation and enough for salvation, so believers need no extra rules or philosophies: set your mind on things above.
基督超乎万有，足以使人得救，信徒无需额外的规条或理学：要思念上面的事。
outline: 与基督一同藏在神里面的生命

author: Paul
保罗
about: Paul thanks a young, persecuted church for its faith and comforts them about believers who have died and the Lord's coming.
保罗为一个年轻且受逼迫之教会的信心感恩，并就已经睡了的信徒和主的再来安慰他们。
outline: 保罗在他们中间的工作
Holy living and the Lord's coming
圣洁的生活与主的再来

author: Paul
保罗
about: Paul corrects the idea that the day of the Lord has already come, and tells idle believers to work quietly.
保罗纠正“主的日子已经到了”的说法，并劝那些不做工的信徒要安静做工。

author: Paul
保罗
about: Paul instructs his young co-worker in Ephesus on false teaching, prayer, church leaders, widows, and godliness with contentment.
保罗指导在以弗所的年轻同工，论及假教训、祷告、教会领袖、寡妇，以及敬虔加上知足。

author: Paul
保罗
date: c. AD 66–67, from prison in Rome
约主后66–67年，写于罗马狱中
about: Paul's last letter, written near his death: be strong, hold to Scripture, preach the word, for I have finished the race.
保罗临终前的最后一封信：要刚强，持守圣经，务要传道，因为当跑的路我已经跑尽了。

author: Paul
保罗
about: Paul tells Titus to appoint elders in Crete and teach sound doctrine that leads to good works, because God's grace has appeared.
保罗吩咐提多在克里特设立长老，教导纯正的道理，使人热心行善，因为神救众人的恩典已经显明。
outline: 向各人教导纯正的道理

author: Paul
保罗
about: A short personal appeal: Paul asks Philemon to welcome back his runaway slave Onesimus as a brother in Christ.
一封简短的私人请托：保罗请腓利门接纳逃跑的奴隶阿尼西母，把他当作主里的弟兄。

author: Unknown
作者不详
about: Jesus is better than angels, Moses and the old priesthood; his one sacrifice is final, so hold fast and run with endurance.
耶稣超越天使、摩西和旧约的祭司职分；他一次献上的祭永远有效，因此要持守信仰，存心忍耐奔跑。

author: James, the brother of Jesus
耶稣的兄弟雅各
about: Practical wisdom for scattered believers: faith that is real shows itself in patience, a tamed tongue, care for the poor and good works.
给分散各处之信徒的实用智慧：真实的信心会在忍耐、勒住舌头、关怀贫穷人和行善上显明出来。

author: Peter
彼得
about: Peter encourages believers suffering as strangers in the world: they have a living hope and should follow Christ's example in suffering.
彼得鼓励在世上作客旅、正受苦难的信徒：他们有活泼的盼望，当效法基督受苦的榜样。

author: Peter
彼得
about: Peter's last words: grow in grace, beware of false teachers, and do not doubt that the Lord will come.
彼得的临别赠言：要在恩典上长进，提防假师傅，不要怀疑主必再来。

author: John the apostle
使徒约翰
about: Written so that believers may know they have eternal life: God is light, God is love, and those born of him walk in truth and love one another.
写这书是要叫信徒知道自己有永生：神就是光，神就是爱，从神生的人行在真理中，并且彼此相爱。

author: John the elder
长老约翰
about: A short note to a "chosen lady" and her children: walk in truth and love, and do not welcome false teachers.
写给“蒙拣选的太太”和她儿女的短信：要行在真理和爱中，不可接待假师傅。

author: John the elder
长老约翰
about: A note to Gaius praising his welcome of travelling teachers, and warning about Diotrephes who loves to be first.
写给该犹的短信，称赞他接待巡回传道的人，并警告好为首的丢特腓。

author: Jude, brother of James
雅各的弟兄犹大
about: A sharp warning against ungodly people who have crept into the church: contend for the faith and keep yourselves in God's love.
严厉警告那些偷偷混进教会的不敬虔之人：要竭力争辩真道，保守自己常在神的爱中。
outline: 保守自己常在神的爱中

author: John, on the island of Patmos
在拔摩岛上的约翰
about: Visions given to John: letters to seven churches, the Lamb on the throne, judgments on a rebellious world, and a new heaven and new earth.
约翰所得的异象：写给七个教会的书信、宝座上的羔羊、对悖逆世界的审判，以及新天新地。
